articles.summary: Union Pacific reported third quarter 2026 net income of $2.1 billion, up 16%, and diluted earnings per share of $3.49, up 16%, compared to reported third quarter 2025 net income of $1.8 billion and diluted EPS of $3.01.
articles.title: Union Pacific Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

articles.summary: Union Pacific Corporation (NYSE: UNP) will release third quarter 2026 financial and operating results on Thursday, Oct. 22, 2026, at 7:45 a.m. ET. The company’s management team will host a conference call and live webcast at 8:45 a.m. ET.
articles.title: Union Pacific Corporation Announces Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release Date

articles.summary: After a six-year hiatus, Union Pacific's Living Legend No. 844 is returning to the rails. The legendary steam locomotive will join Big Boy No. 4014 for Union Pacific's historic holiday tour this November, marking the first public appearance for No. 844 since the pair traveled together in 2019 to celebrate the 150th anniversary of the driving of the Golden Spike in Utah.
articles.title: No. 844 to Reunite with Big Boy for Holiday Tour | Union Pacific

articles.summary: From delivering the materials that build America to transporting the equipment that helps defend it, Union Pacific Railroad plays a vital role in keeping the nation moving.
articles.title: Union Pacific Supports One of the Largest Military Movements by Rail

articles.summary: Union Pacific Railroad today announced Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer Jennifer Hamann will retire in early 2027, concluding a remarkable 35-year career that helped shape the railroad through decades of growth, transformation and industry leadership.
articles.title: Union Pacific Chief Financial Officer Jennifer Hamann to Retire After 35 Years of Service

articles.summary: Union Pacific welcomed customers to Omaha for its Tips, Tools & Technology Day, a collaborative event focused on enhancing the customer experience through technology, process improvements and direct customer feedback.
articles.title: Union Pacific Brings Customers Together to Shape the Future Customer Experience

articles.summary: Former Labor Secretary Lori Chavez-DeRemer recently raised questions about what our proposed combination with Norfolk Southern means for railroad workers and customers. Those questions deserve a straight answer, so let’s put them on the table.
articles.title: Let's Talk Facts About the Union Pacific-Norfolk Southern Merger
